findings.detail: The extracted fair-value sum includes a separately presented $406.514 million investment schedule in addition to the filing's $1,815.082 million portfolio total.

rationale: The filing reports March 2026 portfolio fair value of $1,815.082 million at table 42 row 12. The extracted position sum is $2,221.596 million, an excess of exactly $406.514 million. Table 52 row 17 is a separately presented Investments Total with fair value of $406.514 million, exactly tying to the residual. The conservation failure is therefore a real full-schedule look-through/double-count extraction defect, not a bad filing anchor.
